project_goal: Find independent dated Arctic Tern breeding observations from Denmark before / during 1976–2005 target years; determine whether a source-neighbor can be treated as contemporaneously documented, without inventing colony availability or making a new predictive claim.

external_dataset.name: DOF/BirdLife Denmark - Observations from DOFbasen
external_dataset.matching_rule: exact accepted Sterna paradisaea GBIF matched species; no other tern species or broad family names
external_dataset.sample_details: 1992-07-04 Mandø (Ribe Kommune): 48–52 breeding pairs, independent site/year support example only, not linked to a tern v1 catalogue site.
external_dataset.source_bias: Mostly opportunistic sightings; region/year digitization coverage uneven; breeding records only a subset; vulnerable breeding records may have coordinates blurred with 25 km uncertainty
external_dataset.temporal_asof: The current 2026 GBIF/DOF database may contain retrospective entries, so an observation year is NOT a record-publication or database-ingest time.

mandatory_predicates: taxonKey == GBIF species match Sterna paradisaea
outputs: official dataset UUID/title/DOI/license metadata and SHA
matched exact taxon accepted scientific name, rank and ID
five coordinate-bearing Sterna paradisaea count summaries without individual records
official GBIF API response SHA256 and request URL sans secret
no_claims: GBIF presence implies breeding or export potential
GBIF observation year implies information already available by that year
negative historical count implies ecological absence
stop_if: one of the required window count requests fails

stage1_requires_separate_premodel_freeze.purpose: If pre-2005 coordinate-bearing occurrences exist, inspect fixed capped samples for explicit breeding evidence code and uncertainty; then seek original DOF Ynglepar site/year evidence and crosswalk to tern source coords only in a NEW stage2 protocol.
evidence_tiers: T0: occurrence of target species, no reproduction field
T1: source independently reports breeding pairs/nest/chicks, dated and species-specific
T2: T1 plus precise GPS or site centroid + uncertainty bound <=2 km, with source independence and non-use of destination/outcome
T3: T2 plus same target-year/specified immediately prior-year evidence and independently verifiable data recorded before target event; only this could plausibly support strict as-of claim

source_specific_limitations.official_NOVANA_monitoring_start: 2006 (after original 1976–2005 movements); recent site-level counts cannot directly prove former source colony-year occupancy
source_specific_limitations.DOF_Atlas_I: 1971–1974 presence grid is too coarse to prove site-year source at a 2-km positional tolerance
source_specific_limitations.original_Danish_Tern_Group: 15,015 raw ringing/return records from 242 breeding colonies reportedly held privately; not present in published Dryad 1,090 derived event tables; from same provenance, not independent.
